headline: Premier Explosives Limited: Updates
sum: Updates - Premier Cumulative Capital Private ltd  has submitted to  the Exchange a copy of Pre-offer advertisement in accordance with Regulation 18(7) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011, and Subsequent amendments thereto SEBI (SAST)…
detail: Updates - Premier Cumulative Capital Private ltd  has submitted to  the Exchange a copy of Pre-offer advertisement in accordance with Regulation 18(7) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011, and Subsequent amendments thereto SEBI (SAST) Regulations, and Corrigendum to the Detailed Public statement with respect to the open offer, for the attention of the public shareholders of the company.
